evals.prompt: We have 300 color variables in Figma named like 'Blue/500' and components use them directly. Propose a token architecture with dark mode and DTCG output.
evals.expected_output: An architecture with primitive, semantic and component tiers, naming grammar, a DTCG 2025.10 JSON example, a mode strategy, a Figma collection plan and a migration plan with aliases.
expectations: DTCG example uses $value and $type and curly-brace aliases
Components are shown consuming semantic, not primitive, tokens
Dark mode switches at the semantic tier
Migration keeps old names as deprecated aliases
